notes: Lead: Emily Rhodes (Head of CX). Use-case: automate triage + summarization for email+ticket flows + auto-tagging for routing/macros. Wants high precision tags (>=95%) for routing to subject-matter queues. POC ask: 2-week pilot on 6 months of historical tickets (Zendesk export), include email threads. Quote from call: "If tagging misses, ops noise goes up — must be conservative with confidence thresholds." Concern: downtime/spike behavior — heavy weekly spikes from promos and Black Friday-style events. Strong appetite for canary + fallback: prefer Dedicated for peak predictability, but open to Hosted for POC. Security: must pass SSO/SAML integration, KMS for key management, SOC2 plus audit logs surfaced to their SIEM. Data residency: US only. Retention request: 6 months of derived data, raw ticket data must remain in customer storage. Integration notes: need Zendesk triggers/macros mapping doc; they prefer tags -> macros triggering SLA updates and custom fields. Acceptance criteria: auto-summaries match agent TL;DRs 90%+ by automated evals, tagging precision >=95% on top-10 tags, end-to-end latency for summarization p95 <=350ms. Operational concerns: must show graceful degradation (fallback to smaller model / stub labeler) during spikes. POC deliverables: pipeline for ingest + de-id, sample dashboard (latency/cost/tagging precision), playbook for rollback.
